coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
Making and eating breakfast, packing a cold lunch and water bottle for the heatwave day
Changing into work clothes and collecting bag and work badge
Commuting to the hospital by public transport (bus/train, walking)
Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing patients, running rehabilitation and mobility treatment sessions
Lunch break at the hospital, eating and resting in a cool area
Continuing physiotherapy work: patient treatment sessions, exercise programs and clinical notes
Commuting home from the hospital by public transport (bus/train, walking)
Cooking and eating dinner while keeping the air conditioner off during the grid peak
Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
Relaxing with cool drinks and watching TV, keeping the air conditioner off until the 8pm grid peak ends
Taking a cool shower and getting ready for bed
Reviewing physiotherapy clinical notes and reading professional material on the computer
Winding down with light reading and preparing the room for sleep
